items: 【Night Stand Set of 2】Our bed side table comes with a fabric drawer, desktop, and a mesh shelf that offers ample storage space. Stow away books, electronics, or bedtime essentials, this couch side table has got you covered. Huuger

【Style Stands Out】 The metal mesh is not only sturdy but also gives a modern industrial vibe, perfect for displaying your favorite decor items. The fabric storage dresser's space-conscious design with middle drawer brings more possibilities to your home’s aesthetic. Multiple colours are available

【Perfect for Any Room, Big or Small】Versatility is key! From the bedroom to the living room, or even your dorm. Its compact design makes nightstand with drawer an ideal choice for small spaces, providing essential storage without compromising on style. Use it as a nightstand, a side table, and even a mini bookshelf

【Stable and Durable】Wobbly tables are a thing of the past. With adjustable feet, a sturdy metal frame, and high-quality particle board, this living room side table stands firm on any surface. It’s perfect for those who like to rearrange their furniture or live in places with uneven floors
【Easy Assembly】With clear instructions, provided tools, and numbered components, this bedroom side table is ready for use in just 30 minutes. No complicated steps, just simple and quick assembly
